package.name: aav_safety_filter_rs
package.description: The safety filter for the automatic drivers, in Rust (rclrs), in shadow by default: trims each command by the least that keeps the car able to stop (a CBF on the stopping law), inside its lane (CBFs on a look-ahead point) and settling on the lane's line (a soft Lyapunov term) (TODO 104, K1). The maths is the safety-filter crate, with no ROS.
